selectionBasis: Of 150 inventory rows, 43 are already written (54 posts in 2026-09-25-miss-you-30 plus 905 live). 91 remain. The English side is exhausted; the remaining volume is non-English. Rows ranked by MEASURED winnability, not by the inventory's expected_clicks column, because its weakness counts are mostly SERP-ARCHETYPE (inferred) and the SERP-MEASURED ones were US-served. Two spot-checks proved the gap: de-de returns ten established German magazines against an inventory score of 4 weak; tr-tr has wikiHow at #1 against 'no editorial page exists'.

rows.keyword: diferencia entre te extraño y te echo de menos
rows.note: Regional split: extrañar (LatAm) vs echar de menos (Spain). Verify against RAE and CORPES/CREA frequency, not from memory.
Netflix series 'Te echo de menos' owns the bare head term in Spain — confirm on the SERP and say so. Etymology of 'echar de menos' from Portuguese 'achar menos' is a real, checkable claim.

rows.keyword: te extraño en ingles como se dice
rows.note: Spanish-speaker asking for the English. Cover I miss you vs I long for you vs register.

rows.keyword: como decir te extraño sin decirlo
rows.note: Spanish twin of the English c02 winner, which is live as say-i-miss-you-without-saying-it — do NOT translate that post, measure this SERP and build for it.

rows.keyword: saudade ou saudades qual o certo
rows.note: Singular vs plural usage question. Verify against a named Portuguese grammar/dictionary (Priberam, Michaelis, VOLP).
The untranslatability claim is a LEAD, not a fact — BRIEF.md section 3. Test it.

rows.keyword: saudade em ingles como se diz
rows.note: Sibling of o-que-significa-saudade — one is meaning, one is translation. State the split; cross-link.
The dative construction — 'you are missing FROM me' — is the real hook. Verify against a named source, not memory.

rows.keyword: comment dire tu me manques autrement
rows.note: Incumbents on this cluster are product blogs (Lovebox, Flexilivre) — the same play as ours. Say what they do not.
Italian 'mi manchi' has the same dative shape as French 'tu me manques' — the subject is the person missed. Cross-link the French row if both land.

rows.keyword: come dire mi manchi in modo originale

rows.note: Number-code shorthand. The English sibling miss-you-number-code-meaning is WRITTEN — read it, do not translate it, and state the split. German codes differ (e.g. 143 is English-derived); verify which actually circulate in German.

rows.keyword: wie sage ich ihm dass ich ihn vermisse
rows.note: The de-de listicle SERPs are owned by national magazines (brigitte, wunderweib, tag24) — this advice-shaped query is the one German opening worth testing. Measure it.

Best measured winnability in this wave: forum/Q&A-held (kizlarsoruyor x2, yandex yacevap x2, uludagsozluk, donanimhaber). CORRECTION to the inventory: wikiHow Turkey holds #1, so 'no editorial page exists' is FALSE. English sibling what-to-reply-when-someone-says-i-miss-you is WRITTEN — read it, do not translate it.
Turkish agglutination: özledim already carries 'I' and past tense. That is the explainer no listicle gives.
kangen vs rindu is a real register split — verify against KBBI (kbbi.kemdikbud.go.id), the national dictionary.
Javanese has speech levels (ngoko/krama) — the honorific choice changes the line. Verify the level of every form you print; ISO jav.

rows.keyword: cara bilang kangen tanpa bilang kangen
скучаю по тебе или за тобой как правильно
rows.note: The по/за case dispute is a genuine prescriptive-usage question. Cite Gramota.ru and a named academic grammar; say which is standard and which is regional/colloquial. Keyword is native script — the inventory romanised it for CSV safety.

rows.keyword: aitai in english how to say
rows.note: ENGLISH page — a learner query. 会いたい is 'I want to see you', not 'I miss you'; Japanese has no direct equivalent. Verify against a named dictionary and Tatoeba. Link the live hub /blog/i-miss-you-in-different-languages.
ENGLISH page. 보고 싶다 is literally 'want to see'. The written sibling i-miss-you-in-korean covers the general question — READ IT, state the split, cross-link. Abort if it already owns this.

rows.keyword: wo xiang ni meaning in english
rows.note: ENGLISH page, learner query. 我想你 is literally "I think of you" — 想 spans think/want/miss, so whether it means "miss" is contextual. Verify against a named dictionary plus Tatoeba; link the live hub /blog/i-miss-you-in-different-languages.

Sibling of saudade-em-ingles-como-se-diz: THAT row is the untranslatable noun, THIS row is the ordinary verb phrase people actually say. State the split and cross-link. Priberam redirects to /pt-pt/ — request /pt-br/ explicitly.

French to Arabic. Arabic marks the addressee gender, so there is no single answer — that is the post. Two Arabic siblings are WRITTEN in ../2026-09-25-miss-you-30/blogs/ (i-miss-you-in-arabic, how-to-say-i-miss-you-in-arabic-to-a-woman): read both, do NOT translate them, cite the instruments not the siblings.

Italian to Spanish. Both have the dative shape (mi manchi / me haces falta) but Spanish ALSO has te extrano / te echo de menos, which invert the subject. That contrast is the angle. Sibling diferencia-entre-te-extrano-y-te-echo-de-menos covers the Spanish pair — cross-link, stay in the Italian lane.

Turkish to Kurdish. Kurmanji vs Sorani is a real split with different scripts (Latin vs Arabic-based) — say which you are giving. Verify ISO codes at iso639-3.sil.org (kmr, ckb, kur macrolanguage). The English sibling i-miss-you-in-kurdish is WRITTEN — read it, do not translate it; it already found a diacritic error in its #1 result.

rows.keyword: ik mis je nu al betekenis
rows.note: "I already miss you" — said before or at the moment of parting, not after. The anticipatory sense is the whole question. Verify against Van Dale / Woordenlijst; establish whether the phrase is idiomatic or compositional.
Polish tesknic takes za + instrumental — the same case-government question the Russian row covers for po/za. Verify against PWN (sjp.pwn.pl) and NKJP. Cross-link the Russian row if it lands.

STRAPI - THE PRECISE FACT, so the quiescence pass does not flip items on a wrong reading. TWO different endpoints have been conflated. (a) LOCAL Strapi at 127.0.0.1:1337 is genuinely DOWN - the ozledim-demenin agent tested it properly with `nc -z` and got CLOSED/REFUSED, and it was right to say so. (b) PRODUCTION at https://strapi.subhsandesh.in/api/articles IS UP and is what the orchestrator used on 2026-09-26 to confirm all 30 slugs free (total:0 each) and to confirm which cross-link targets are live. So the checklist's slug check IS satisfiable - via the public API, reached with ctx_execute or the browser, NOT with curl or WebFetch, which this project's CLAUDE.md blocks and which is why several agents concluded the service was unreachable. When flipping the ~10 false failures, cite the production check; do NOT flip a post that failed it for a different, genuine reason (e.g. sibling cross-links that 404 until those batches publish, or an agent that correctly reported the local instance down).

ORCHESTRATOR ERROR #3 - 'PDFs do not parse here' is FALSE and I repeated it in roughly forty agent prompts across both waves. VERIFIED 2026-09-27: pdftotext (poppler 26.04.0) is at /usr/local/bin/pdftotext, and the i-miss-you-in-morse-code agent used `pdftotext -layout` on a 1.4 MB ITU Recommendation and parsed its clause tables programmatically. Not worth rewriting finished posts over, but any future wave must drop the claim, and a remediation pass could upgrade the weakest citations to full-text reads.
